info.title: GestorIA API
info.description: SPEC-009. Money is a string with two decimals, dates are ISO-8601, errors are RFC 9457 problem+json.

get.summary: The API can serve requests: its database answers. 503 database-unavailable when it does not.
Every tax year the API holds a configuration for, oldest first.
One tax year's configuration: its hash, regions and declared gaps.

post.summary: Runs the set-aside estimator on the console's input file for a tax year.

get.summary: The stored profiles: none before the first is created, one after.

post.summary: Stores the profile. Local mode keeps one: a second is refused with 409.

put.summary: Replaces a stored profile with the one in the body.

delete.summary: Deletes the profile and everything stored for it. Nothing is kept: export it first to keep a copy.

get.summary: Everything stored for the profile, in one versioned document (SPEC-009 §2.1). Personal financial data: sent with Cache-Control: no-store.

post.summary: Restores an export (SPEC-009 §2.1) into an empty installation. The same file again changes nothing; anything else stored is a 409.

requestBody.description: An export file (SPEC-009 §2.1), at most 16777216 bytes.

get.summary: Runs the set-aside estimator on a stored profile for a quarter of its tax year, with no closed quarter stated.
Every obligation of the profile's tax year, in due-date order: Modelo 130, 303 and 349, the monthly TGSS cuota and the Renta true-up.
The upcoming calendar as an RFC 5545 export; amounts=true adds each obligation's known amount to its title, lang picks the event text's language.

post.summary: Imports a bank statement, the file itself as the body. A line an earlier import stored is not stored again.

requestBody.description: The statement file as exported by the bank, at most 2097152 bytes.

get.summary: The stored movements in booking-date order: all of them, a year's, or a quarter's of that year.

post.summary: Runs the set-aside estimator on a stored profile and returns one quarter's Modelo 130, its casillas and trace.
Runs the set-aside estimator on a stored profile and returns the annual true-up gap, due window and trace.

SetAsideInputDocument.description: The console's input file, byte for byte: src/GestorIA.Cli/README.md describes every field.

apiKey.description: The local installation's API key (SPEC-009 §3). The health checks do not need it.
apiKey.name: X-Api-Key
